title: Pantheon CapabilitySnapshot
description: Effective capability set computed once at session start. Immutable for the session lifetime — policy changes in the registry do not affect an in-flight session.

persona_id.description: Persona this snapshot was computed for.

generated_at.description: When the snapshot was computed (UTC ISO-8601).

effective_tools.description: List of tool names/IDs allowed in this session.

effective_skills.description: List of skill names/IDs allowed in this session.

effective_workflows.description: List of workflow names/IDs allowed in this session.

restrictions.description: List of explicit restrictions applied to this session.

source_refs.description: Policy document refs used to compute this snapshot (route_policy, consult_policy, RBAC rules).
